scope: Static official-document/package review only. No EDA executable run, build, hardware access, private database decoding or modification of existing VG/database/bitstream.
current_custom_64_SP_128KiB_applicabilit: UNKNOWN: public support is documented for Gowin_PicoRV32/EMPU ITCM. No arbitrary instance selector or custom mapping procedure was found.

inputs.bin_file: Raw CPU software binary, not the FPGA g2_top.bin bitstream and not INIT_RAM text.
inputs.itcm_size: ITCM capacity in KB. Current V1.6 README supports 8,16,32,64,128,256,512.
inputs.posp_file: Matching Post-Place mapping file generated by the same hardware PNR build.

output: New fabric .fs. Official Figure3-5 and package example use new_gowin_picorv32.fs.
official_hardware_reuse_statement: IPUG913 section3.3 explicitly permits reuse of fixed hardware bitstream when hardware is unchanged; each firmware update then uses merge_bit.

documented_device_scope.IPUG532_section3_5: Explicitly includes GW5A/T/ST/S-138, GW5AT-75, GW5A/R/S-25, GW5A/T-60, GW5AT/RT-15 and selected older families.
documented_device_scope.GW5AT_138_versionC_with_1_9_12_04_specif: Not performed; family support does not establish arbitrary custom memory layout support.

current_official_package.old_unversioned_link: Gowin_PicoRV32.zip resolves to old V1.2 with different posp_parse+merge_bit CLI. Do not use that older package for the current AroraV workflow.

local_installation.MemEditor_dll: Present; its filename is not evidence of an arbitrary post-PNR INIT replacement CLI.
local_installation.Programmer_merge: SUG502 section3.16 appends/merges whole bitstreams at start addresses into SPI Flash .bin. This is not BSRAM INIT replacement.
local_installation.Programmer_conversion: programmer_cli --filestransform is file-format conversion, not the CPU ITCM merge flow.

related_project_options.set_option -gen_posp 1: Request .posp from a FUTURE PNR build before freezing. SUG1220 p33/PDF40 says it contains BSRAM placement information, default0. No verified export-from-existing-pr command was found.
related_project_options.set_option -bit_incl_bsram_init 1: Include BSRAM initialization in generated bitstream; not a firmware replacement command. SUG1220 p51/PDF58.
related_project_options.set_option -bsram_init_print_mode partia: Column-level BSRAM INIT printing mode for supported138K/75K devices; not arbitrary INIT replacement. SUG1220 pp51-52/PDF58-59.

current_nav_source.line91: nav_ram_sp byte lanes, not the documented Gowin_PicoRV32 ITCM IP.

unresolved_before_use_on_nav: Official confirmation or documentation for actual nav_soc/g_lane/nav_ram_sp synthesized naming and 64-SP ordering.
Genuine corresponding .posp from the exact timing-approved hardware build.
Raw firmware byte/bank mapping. Equal128KiB capacity and validated INIT contents do not alone establish merge-tool compatibility.
Specific current tool compatibility with GW5AT-138C and V1.9.12.04.
